etsy_title: Key of Solomon Starter Ritual Kit | Paperback Grimoire | Candle | Herb Set | Guide | Gift for Practitioner
description:
Starter Solomonic kit — paperback grimoire, candle, small herb/tool set, and an education layer that explains what each piece is for.

HOW IT WORKS:
1. Order the kit
2. We pack paperback + tools + printed guide
3. Tracked shipping

WHAT YOU GET:
- Paperback Key of Solomon (layout we designed from public-domain text)
- Candle + small tool/herb set
- Printed education layer (the part reviewers love)
- Gift-ready packaging

Historical craft, not a spell guarantee. 5% charity on every sale.
